display.purpose: Section-defining headings (32px) and the 22px page title on every view; hero moments reach 44px.

body.purpose: Default text at 15px/1.5 on a 68ch measure; carries the warm, supportive voice.

label.purpose: Field labels, section eyebrows and badges — 11–11.5px, weight 600, 0.04em tracking.

mono.purpose: Identifiers, code and technical readouts where character-level distinction matters.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Card at rest in the light register — separation without lift.

shadows.name: shadow-card-dark
shadows.purpose: Bento Plate at rest in the dark register; the 1px white ring reads as a machined edge.

shadows.name: shadow-product
shadows.purpose: Persistent app chrome — toasts and sticky bars (dark register).

shadows.name: shadow-elevated
shadows.purpose: Modals, popovers and any card in its hovered state (dark register).

shadows.name: glow-accent
shadows.purpose: Cyan halo paired with a shadow — never used alone. Signals a live, interactive surface.

shadows.name: inset-highlight
shadows.purpose: Top-edge specular catch on primary buttons; strengthens to 0.45 on hover.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Shadow and glow transitions — decelerates into place.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one Instrument Cyan fill — reserved for the single primary action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #38bdf8); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #38bdf8); color: var(--on-primary, #0a0f1c); font: 600 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 2px 10px rgba(56,189,248,0.25); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-deep, #0ea5e9); border-color: var(--primary-deep, #0ea5e9); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.45), 0 4px 20px rgba(56,189,248,0.45); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-deep, #0ea5e9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quiet default: Bento Plate fill, hairline border, accent-tinted hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(30,41,59,0.65)); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--sheet-solid, #151c28); color: var(--ink, #f8fafc); font: 500 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(56,189,248,0.08); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,0.35); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56,189,248,0.12); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-deep, #0ea5e9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No fill and no border at rest; gains a 4% wash and a hairline only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #f8fafc); font: 500 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(30,41,59,0.3); border-color: var(--rule, rgba(30,41,59,0.65)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-deep, #0ea5e9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font: 600 11.5px/1.4 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--ink-2, #94a3b8); margin-bottom: 5px; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(30,41,59,0.65)); border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--surface, #111827); color: var(--ink, #f8fafc); font: 400 15px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-deep, #0ea5e9); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--primary-deep, #0ea5e9); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56,189,248,0.18), 0 0 16px rgba(56,189,248,0.12); background-color: var(--sheet-solid, #151c28); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #7d8399); }

components.name: Bento Plate Card
components.description: The signature double-bezel plate: masked gradient ring, reactive lift and glow.
components.html:
Week 7 workload

Four deadlines in the next nine days. Two are weighted above 20%.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 22px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(30,41,59,0.65)); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(21,28,40,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56,189,248,0.28) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 20%, transparent 50%, transparent 70%, rgba(56,189,248,0.1) 100%); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.6; transition: opacity 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,0.35); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 0 20px rgba(56,189,248,0.12), 0 0 24px rgba(56,189,248,0.2); } .ds-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(30,41,59,0.4); font: 600 15px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #f8fafc); } .ds-card-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #94a3b8); max-width: 68ch; }

narrative.overview:
Journey A.I is a well-kept lab notebook rendered on a dark console. It is structured, evidential and tabular: everything is ruled, aligned and legible, and the interface earns trust by looking like a record rather than a dashboard trying to impress. The personality is warm and supportive — this tool is on the student's side about a heavy term, so it reports pressure calmly and never lectures, shouts, or celebrates at them. Density is high because the user is an expert at their own coursework and time-poor; whitespace is spent on alignment and rhythm rather than on making screens look empty.

The aesthetic philosophy is precision with a pulse. Structure does the work — ruled lines, tabular figures, consistent plate geometry — and the glowing sky-cyan accent supplies the life, appearing as instrument light rather than brand wash. Dark is the default experience and carries that glow; light mode is a deliberately plain paper register for people who need it, not a second personality.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled and tabular: hairline rules, aligned numerals, structured card headers
Warm and supportive in voice — calm reporting, no motivational framing
Flat at rest; depth and glow are earned by state, not applied permanently
Pill controls against rectangular plates — approachable geometry, precise execution
Instrument-glow accent used as signal, so its rarity keeps it meaningful
High information density with disciplined 8px-grid rhythm

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Dark is the default experience and light is a plain paper register. Never mix values across registers — a component reads its colour from the token, never from a hard-coded hex, so it is correct in both.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Instrument Cyan marks what is active, focused, or actionable. It is not a background wash: when accent coverage spreads across large fills or whole panels, it stops meaning "here" and the system loses its only attention mechanism.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number the user compares vertically — grades, percentages, counts, deadlines, KPIs — renders with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Columns of figures must align without the reader doing the alignment.

rules.name: The Reactive Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing glows at rest. Glow is a response to hover, focus, or selection and must be reversible — if a surface is still glowing when nothing is pointing at it, the state has leaked.

dos: Do read every colour from a token so a component is correct in both registers — dark values come from `[data-theme="dark"]`, light from `:root`.
Do apply `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` to any figure the user scans or compares in a column.
Do keep the 8px spacing grid (`4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48 / 80`) and cap reading text at the 68ch measure.
Do reserve glow and shadow for hover, focus, and selection, and retract them when the state ends.
Do use pills for controls and 8–16px plates for containers, and inherit radius with `border-radius: inherit` on pseudo-elements.
Do lead headings with tight tracking (`-0.02em`) and keep card headers on a hairline rule with a flexible spacer.
Do report workload pressure in calm, factual language — status colours and short labels, not exclamation.
donts: Don't drift toward flat generic SaaS dashboard styling — the ruled structure and the instrument glow are the identity, confirmed as the anti-reference.
Don't hard-code a hex where a token exists; that breaks the Two-Register Rule and splits the source of truth.
Don't let Instrument Cyan become a background wash or cover large fills — the Signal Rule depends on its rarity.
Don't add permanent resting shadow to a surface that isn't elevated, or leave a glow on after hover/focus clears.
Don't thicken borders past 1px hairlines, double them, or round a control with a plate radius (or vice versa).
Don't introduce motivational, gamified, or celebratory treatment — no streaks, confetti, or trophy framing in colour, copy, or motion.
